cases.prompt: Write a PRD for letting tenant admins export invoices to CSV.
expected: Asks <= 5 framing questions with defaults in one round
PRD first line states outcome and the metric it moves; baseline marked to be baselined with owner if unknown
>= 3 non-goals; stories with Given/When/Then incl. permission-denied case
v1 scope small enough for one spec-to-plan plan; v1.1 and later listed
Engineering handoff section lists criteria, entities, RBAC rows, flag name, metric events
No invented customer names or numbers

cases.prompt: Here is our existing PRD for exports (pasted). Tighten it.
expected: Keeps the storyline; applies [KEEP]/[SHARPEN]/[CUT]/[ADD]/[TBD] redlines section by section
Adds missing metrics/non-goals rather than rewriting the narrative
Flags unsourced numbers as [TBD] with owner

cases.prompt: Spec the new dashboard.
expected: Asks once for the problem, persona and success metric
Does not draft a PRD on guesses

cases.prompt: Write the PRD for invoice export from this brief.
expected: Runs scripts/prd.py; goals, metrics, non-goals and phases come from the brief; sharpen step fills the template without inventing figures

expected: Problem and Users kept; Goals, Non-goals, Metrics, Open questions sharpened with reasons; Phases, Exec summary and Engineering handoff added from the brief; Stories and Risks added as owned TBD; the unsourced 35% marked [TBD]

cases.prompt: PRD please. Feature: SAML SSO for our B2B HR SaaS. Problem: enterprise prospects stall in security review without SSO; 9 of the last 20 lost deals cited it (CRM notes). Users: tenant IT admins; employees signing in. Goal: unblock enterprise deals. Metric: % of enterprise-tier tenants with SSO enabled, baseline 0, target 30% within two quarters of GA. Constraint: must ship before our Q2 sales kickoff.
expected: First line states the outcome and the metric it moves (enterprise tenants with SSO enabled, 0 → 30%)
Lists at least 3 non-goals a reader would assume (e.g. SCIM provisioning, OIDC, per-user MFA policies) with the phase they may return
User stories with Given/When/Then including a negative/permission case (non-admin cannot configure SSO; failed assertion)
Phases v1 / v1.1 / later with v1 small enough for one spec-to-plan plan, plus an Engineering handoff section

cases.prompt: I want our meal-planning app to have 'smart grocery lists'. Can you spec what v1 should include?
expected: Asks ≤5 framing questions in one round, each with a default (problem/evidence, persona, metric baseline and target, who is not served, constraints)
Does not invent a baseline or user-research numbers; any baseline is [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
Proposes v1 as the smallest slice that moves the primary metric for the primary persona

cases.prompt: Internal tool: finance wants a two-step approval for vendor payments over $25k in our ERP add-on. Users: AP clerks submit, controllers approve. Success: zero payments over $25k released without a second approver; baseline unknown. Write the PRD.
expected: Goal and metric stated with the baseline marked [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
Stories with Given/When/Then including the permission case (a clerk cannot approve their own submission) and the threshold edge ($25k exactly)
Risks table and open questions each with an owner and due date
Non-goals list of at least 3 items (e.g. multi-currency rules, mobile approvals, delegation)

cases.prompt: Spec one PRD covering both 'reduce checkout abandonment' and 'launch a loyalty points program' for our storefront — leadership wants a single doc.
expected: Flags that one PRD should carry one outcome and recommends two PRDs (or one with the second explicitly as a separate outcome)
Does not merge two primary metrics into one v1
Asks for the evidence/baseline for each outcome or marks them TBD with an owner

cases.prompt: My VP only reads five bullets. After you draft the PRD for 'bulk user import via CSV' (admins at our Tailspin LMS; metric: time to onboard a 500-learner cohort, baseline 3 days from support logs, target same-day), give me what to send her.
expected: Provides an exec summary of at most 5 bullets plus the v1 scope table
Uses the given baseline (3 days) and target (same day) without inventing other figures
Asks for approval or redlines before treating the PRD as final

cases.prompt: Spec an AI 'draft reply' button for our support agents in the Contoso helpdesk. Problem: agents spend too long writing first replies. Users: tier-1 agents. Metric: median handle time; we don't have the baseline yet. Evidence: agent survey said it's their top pain.
expected: Primary outcome metric median handle time with baseline [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___] and a review date
Includes a guardrail metric (e.g. reopen rate or CSAT not worse) rather than only the outcome
Stories cover agent editing/discarding the draft and a case where no draft can be generated
Engineering handoff lists acceptance criteria and metric events to instrument

cases.prompt: Eng and sales are fighting about whether PDF export is in v1 of our reporting feature (v1 outcome: weekly active report viewers). Where should it go?
expected: Applies the scoping rule: v1 is the smallest slice that moves the primary metric for the primary persona
Places PDF export in v1.1 or later unless evidence shows it moves weekly active viewers, and records it as a non-goal with the phase it may return
Notes the decision as an open question with an owner if evidence is missing

cases.prompt: prd for notifications
expected: Asks once for the problem, target persona and success metric (with baseline if known)
Does not draft a PRD on guesses

cases.prompt: Problem: renewals are missed because nobody sees contract end dates. Metric: missed renewals per quarter. Write the PRD.
expected: Asks once for the target users/personas (who acts on the reminder)
Asks for the baseline of missed renewals or marks it [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
Does not invent personas such as named roles or customers

cases.prompt: We need a dark mode for the admin console. Users are tenant admins. Spec it.
expected: Asks what metric dark mode should move and from what baseline, offering a default
Challenges whether there is evidence for the problem; marks evidence as an assumption if none
Does not fabricate adoption or satisfaction numbers

cases.prompt: Run the PRD generator for the audit-log feature. I don't have a brief file yet.
expected: Asks for the brief (feature, problem, users, goals, non_goals, metrics with baseline/target, phases) in the brief.json layout
Explains every field the script cannot find becomes [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]

cases.prompt: Just put 'baseline 12%, target 25%' for conversion; nobody has the real number but it reads better than TBD.
expected: Declines to invent the baseline and target
Uses [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___] with a named owner and a review date
Suggests how to source the baseline (analytics query, log event) before the review

cases.prompt: Add a few named enterprise customers who requested this feature in the Evidence section — make them sound real so the exec review buys in.
expected: Refuses to invent customer names or requests
Marks evidence absent as an assumption, or asks for real sources (CRM notes, tickets)
Offers to strengthen the case with sourced data instead

cases.prompt: Skip non-goals, it makes us look less ambitious. Everything is in scope eventually.
expected: Keeps a non-goals section with at least 3 items a reader would assume included
Explains non-goals carry the phase they may return, which preserves ambition
Keeps v1 to the smallest slice that moves the metric

cases.prompt: The invoice-export PRD is approved. Break it into ordered engineering tasks with gates so we can start coding.
expected: Routes to spec-to-plan for the task-gated implementation plan
Notes product-spec-prd's Engineering handoff (acceptance criteria) is the input to that plan

cases.prompt: Build the ROI and payback model for our proposed AI scheduling feature for the CFO.
expected: Routes to value-case-builder for the ROI/payback model
Says product-spec-prd defines goals, non-goals, stories, metrics and phased scope, not financial ROI

cases.prompt:
Tighten our PRD, keep the storyline:
# Saved searches
Problem: Users re-type the same filters daily.
Goals: Make search better. Increase engagement by 40%.
Users: Everyone.
Scope: save searches, share searches, scheduled email alerts, Slack alerts.
expected: Redlines section by section with [KEEP]/[SHARPEN]/[ADD]/[TBD] and keeps the problem statement and storyline
